question: The perimeter of a rectangular garden is 48 m. If the length is 6 m more than the breadth, the area (in m²) of the garden is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of Length (L) and Breadth (B) = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 48 ÷ 2 = 24 m

Given the difference L − B = 6 m

L = (24 + 6) ÷ 2 = 15 m

B = (24 − 6) ÷ 2 = 9 m

Area = L × B = 15 × 9 = 135 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 135 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of rectangular garden = 48 m

Length (L) = Breadth (B) + 6 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b3c8a5077d25803edb0573b2cf36f111ae87860c2a822466ea795cd5a96285e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

Area of rectangle = L × B

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2(B + 6 + B) = 48

⇒ 2(2B + 6) = 48

⇒ 2B + 6 = 24

⇒ 2B = 18

⇒ B = 9 m

⇒ L = 9 + 6 = 15 m

⇒ Area = L × B

⇒ Area = 15 × 9 = 135 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 135 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. All interior angles are exactly 90°.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

Length of diagonal = √(L² + B²). Diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other.

Square as a Rectangle

A square is a special type of rectangle where Length = Breadth. For a square, Area = Side² and Perimeter = 4 × Side.
